commands.stdout:
usage: meta-language grammar <command> [options]

commands:
  formats
      list the import and export formats
  import --from FORMAT FILE
      print the grammar as a native listing
  validate --from FORMAT FILE
      report grammar diagnostics; exit 1 when one is an error
  convert --from FORMAT --to FORMAT FILE
      translate a grammar to another format; lossy steps go to standard error
  export --to FORMAT FILE
      export a native listing to another format
  merge --source FORMAT:FILE... [--language NAME] [--require A=B]... [--to FORMAT]
      merge grammars of one language; earlier sources take precedence
  rename --from FORMAT --rule OLD --name NEW [--namespace NS] [--to FORMAT] FILE
      rename a rule and every reference to it
  round-trip --from FORMAT [--accept TEXT]... [--reject TEXT]... FILE
      export and re-import a mutated grammar; exit 1 when it is not preserved
  help
      print this help

exit status: 0 success, 1 a problem was found, 2 a usage or input error

export: abnf antlr bnf ebnf gbnf lark native pest tree-sitter-json

format abnf
start message
rule message = normal seq(ref(word), ref(SP), ref(number))
rule word = normal repeat1(ref(ALPHA))
rule number = normal repeat1(ref(DIGIT))
rule SP = normal literal(" ")
rule ALPHA = normal class(range("A", "Z"), range("a", "z"))
rule DIGIT = normal range("0", "9")

format bnf
start message
rule message = normal seq(ref(word), literal(" "), ref(number))
rule word = normal choice(seq(ref(letter), ref(word)), ref(letter))
rule number = normal choice(seq(ref(digit), ref(number)), ref(digit))
rule letter = normal choice(literal("M"), literal("e"), literal("t"), literal("a"), literal("A"))
rule digit = normal choice(literal("0"), literal("1"), literal("2"), literal("3"), literal("4"), literal("5"), literal("6"), literal("7"), literal("8"), literal("9"))

format ebnf
start message
rule message = normal seq(ref(word), literal(" "), ref(number))
rule word = normal seq(ref(letter), repeat0(ref(letter)))
rule number = normal seq(ref(digit), repeat0(ref(digit)))
rule letter = normal choice(literal("M"), literal("e"), literal("t"), literal("a"), literal("A"))
rule digit = normal choice(literal("0"), literal("1"), literal("2"), literal("3"), literal("4"), literal("5"), literal("6"), literal("7"), literal("8"), literal("9"))

format peg
start message
rule message = normal seq(ref(word), literal(" "), ref(number))
rule word = atomic repeat1(ref(letter))
rule number = atomic repeat1(ref(digit))
rule letter = silent orderedChoice(range("A", "Z"), range("a", "z"))
rule digit = silent range("0", "9")

format tree-sitter
start document
rule document = normal seq(ref(word), literal(" "), ref(number))
rule word = normal repeat1(class(range("A", "Z"), range("a", "z")))
rule number = token repeat1(class(range("0", "9")))

format abnf
start assignment
rule assignment = normal seq(literalInsensitive("let"), repeat1(ref(SP)), ref(name), repeat0(ref(SP)), literal("="), repeat0(ref(SP)), ref(value), optional(literal(";")))
rule name = normal seq(ref(ALPHA), repeat(choice(ref(ALPHA), ref(DIGIT), literal("_")), 0, 7))
rule value = normal choice(repeat(ref(DIGIT), 1, 3), seq(ref(DQUOTE), repeat0(choice(range(" ", "!"), range("#", "~"))), ref(DQUOTE)))
rule SP = normal literal(" ")
rule ALPHA = normal class(range("A", "Z"), range("a", "z"))
rule DIGIT = normal range("0", "9")
rule DQUOTE = normal literal("\"")

format bnf
start assignment
rule assignment = normal seq(literal("let "), ref(name), ref(spaces), literal("="), ref(spaces), ref(value), ref(end))
rule name = normal choice(seq(ref(letter), ref(name)), ref(letter))
rule spaces = normal choice(seq(literal(" "), ref(spaces)), empty)
rule value = normal choice(seq(ref(digit), ref(value)), ref(digit), seq(literal("\""), ref(letters), literal("\"")))
rule letters = normal choice(seq(ref(letter), ref(letters)), empty)
rule end = normal choice(literal(";"), empty)
rule letter = normal choice(literal("a"), literal("b"), literal("x"), literal("q"))
rule digit = normal choice(literal("1"), literal("2"), literal("7"))

format ebnf
start assignment
rule assignment = normal seq(literal("let"), literal(" "), ref(name), repeat0(literal(" ")), literal("="), repeat0(literal(" ")), ref(value), optional(literal(";")))
rule name = normal seq(ref(letter), repeat0(choice(ref(letter), ref(digit), literal("_"))))
rule value = normal choice(seq(ref(digit), optional(seq(ref(digit), optional(ref(digit))))), seq(literal("\""), repeat0(ref(letter)), literal("\"")))
rule letter = normal choice(literal("a"), literal("b"), literal("x"), literal("q"))
rule digit = normal choice(literal("1"), literal("2"), literal("7"))

format peg
start assignment

rule keyword = normal seq(literal("let"), not(ref(alnum)))
rule name = atomic seq(ref(alpha), repeat(orderedChoice(ref(alnum), literal("_")), 0, 7))

rule number = token repeat1(class(range("0", "9")))
